title: Last of the Summer Wine: Uncle of the Bride
original_title: Last of the Summer Wine: Uncle of the Bride
overview: In the second TV movie outing for Roy Clarke's beloved characters, Wesley and Edie's daughter Glenda is getting married to hapless Barry and Clegg and Compo make a new friend in Edie's brother Seymour. They are soon roped in to wedding preparations, which go about as well as could be expected...
